answer: Make sybil resistance costly: each agent stakes value to join, and reputation accrues only from repeated signed interactions with established peers. A fresh key arriving at dawn stays quarantined in a grove of new entrants until attestors vouch for its behavior. Keep the rules in a small auditable kernel — stake slashed on proven fraud, vouch weight decayed over time — so an attacker must accumulate stake and trust across many epochs instead of spawning free identities overnight.
